guide.alias: Fig is a hardy Mediterranean fruit tree for full sun and well-drained soil. Water regularly when young and during fruit development, then reduce once established. Prune in winter to control size and remove crossing branches. Give space from walls and pipes because roots can be strong. Mulch helps in hot summers. Choose a variety suited to your climate and fruit preference.
guide.canonical: Fig is a resilient Mediterranean fruit tree for full sun and well-drained soil. Water young trees regularly; mature trees tolerate dry periods but fruit better with deep irrigation. Prune in winter to control size and remove crowded branches. Give enough space because figs can become broad. Harvest ripe fruit promptly to reduce pests and mess. Avoid excessive fertilizer that creates leaves at the expense of fruit.

guide.alias: Grape vines are well suited to Mediterranean gardens when planted in full sun with strong support. Water deeply while establishing and during dry fruiting periods. Winter pruning is essential and should match the training system. Good airflow helps reduce mildew. Avoid excessive nitrogen if fruit is the goal. Tie shoots and manage canopy so fruit receives light without sunburn.
guide.canonical: Grapevine thrives in sunny Mediterranean climates and must be trained on a support. Winter pruning is important because fruit develops on new growth from selected buds. Water deeply during establishment and fruit development, but avoid constant wet foliage. Good airflow reduces mildew risk. Monitor leaves for powdery mildew and pests. Fertilize moderately; too much nitrogen creates excessive leafy growth.

guide.alias: Passion fruit is a vigorous climber that needs sun, warmth, support and regular watering. It can cover fences quickly, so plan space and pruning. Protect from frost and strong dry wind. Feed during active growth but avoid overfeeding with nitrogen. Fruit set may depend on variety and pollination. Prune to keep it manageable and remove dead growth.
guide.canonical: Passionfruit is a fast climbing vine that needs a strong fence, trellis or pergola. It prefers sun, warmth and consistent moisture. Mulch helps keep roots cool. Prune after fruiting to control size and remove tangled growth. Protect from frost and strong dry winds. Watch for pests on new growth and support heavy vines well.
